1\. Purpose
===========

This document describes how people move through the site: which screens exist, who can see them, and what happens in each journey, including the unhappy paths. It uses the requirement IDs from the PRD.

===========

3\. Reader journeys
===================

3.1 Discover and read
---------------------

| **Step** | **Reader does** | **System does** | **If something goes wrong** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Opens a shared link to a piece, or the Home page. | Serves the pre-rendered page from the CDN. | Unknown or draft slug: 404 page with links to sections. |
| 2 | Reads. On a poem, line breaks and stanzas are preserved. | No JavaScript needed. | Slow network: text appears first; images load later without shifting layout. |
| 3 | Reaches the end: sees subscribe prompt, share, previous and next. | Previous/next computed within the same section by date. | First or last piece: only one link shows. |
| 4 | Taps Share. | Opens the native share sheet or copies the link. | Unsupported browser: copy link with visible “Copied”. |
| 5 | Opens a section index, scrolls, taps Older. | Loads the next page by cursor. | End of list: Older link not shown. No items: friendly empty state. |

3.2 Subscribe (no account)
--------------------------

![Diagram](data:image/png;base64,)

| **Step** | **Visitor does** | **System does** | **Alternative outcomes** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Types email into the form (Home, end of piece or footer) and presses Subscribe. | Validates in the browser and again on the server. | Invalid email: inline error, nothing sent. Honeypot filled (bot): generic success shown, nothing done. |
| 2 | — | Rate-limit check, then creates a pending record (or reuses an existing one) and sends a confirmation email. | Rate limit hit: message “Too many tries”. Provider failure: error message and nothing saved as confirmed. |
| 3 | Sees “Almost there. Check your inbox…” | Returns the same message whether the address is new, pending or already confirmed. | JavaScript off: page reloads with the same message. |
| 4 | Opens the email and taps the link. | — | Email not received: visitor may submit again (one confirm email per hour per address). |
| 5 | Lands on “Confirm your subscription” and presses Confirm. | Verifies token, marks confirmed, records time. | Expired (48 h): “Link expired” with a form to request a new one. Invalid or used: neutral message and link home. Already confirmed: “You are already subscribed”. |
| 6 | Sees “You are subscribed.” | Subscriber is included in future notifications only. | — |

3.3 Receive an update
---------------------

| **Step** | **Event** | **Outcome** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Author publishes a piece with “Email subscribers” on. | A notification is recorded in the same database transaction as the publish. |
| 2 | Background job runs within moments. | Each confirmed subscriber gets one email: title, preview or full text by type, link to the site, unsubscribe link. |
| 3 | Subscriber taps the link. | The piece opens on the site (Journey 3.1, step 2). |
| 4 | Delivery problem (provider limit, temporary error). | Job retries automatically; unsent emails go out later; the author sees the backlog on the Notifications screen. |
| 5 | Address bounces or the recipient marks spam. | Provider webhook marks that subscriber; they are never emailed again. |

3.4 Unsubscribe
---------------

| **Step** | **Subscriber does** | **System does** | **Alternative outcomes** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Taps “Unsubscribe” in an email, or uses their mail app’s built-in unsubscribe button. | Mail app button: one-click POST handled immediately and silently. Link: opens the unsubscribe page. | Invalid link: neutral message. |
| 2 | Presses Unsubscribe on the page. | Marks unsubscribed with a timestamp. Safe to repeat. | Already unsubscribed: same confirmation. |
| 3 | Sees “You have been unsubscribed” with a Subscribe again link. | No further emails. | — |

4\. Author journeys
===================

4.1 Sign in
-----------

| **Step** | **Author does** | **System does** | **If something goes wrong** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Opens /admin. | No session: redirect to /admin/login. | — |
| 2 | Enters email and signs in (magic link or password, plus code if two-step is on). | Verifies identity and checks the account is on the admin list. | Wrong details: generic “Could not sign in”. Too many attempts: temporary lockout message. Signed in but not admin: “Not allowed” and sign-out. |
| 3 | Lands on the dashboard. | Shows counts and latest notification status. | Session expired later: returned to login, draft safe locally and on server. |

4.2 Write and publish a piece
-----------------------------

![Diagram](data:image/png;base64,)

| **Step** | **Author does** | **System does** | **If something goes wrong** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Taps New and chooses a type (poem, story, reflection, quote). | Opens the editor with fields for that type. | — |
| 2 | Writes the title and text. | Autosaves a draft every few seconds; shows “Saved”. | Offline or save fails: “Not saved” warning stays visible and text is kept in the page; leaving the page warns. |
| 3 | Taps Preview. | Shows the piece in the public layout with a draft banner. | — |
| 4 | Taps Publish. | Shows a confirmation: title, number of confirmed subscribers, “Email subscribers” switch. | Missing required field: blocked with message. |
| 5 | Confirms. | Publishes and records the notification in one transaction, refreshes public pages, queues the emails. | Already published: message, nothing repeated. Queue unavailable: piece is live, notification marked “not sent” with Send now. |
| 6 | Opens Notifications. | Shows sent, failed and pending counts for that piece. | Failures: Retry failed. |

4.3 Edit, unpublish or delete
-----------------------------

| **Action** | **Result** |
| --- | --- |
| Edit a published piece and save | Public page updates within a minute. No email is sent. |
| Unpublish | Piece disappears from lists, feed and sitemap; its URL shows 404. Original date and “already emailed” status are kept. |
| Republish | Returns with its original date. No email is sent again. |
| Delete | Asks the author to confirm by typing the title or pressing a named confirm button; removes the piece permanently. |

4.4 Books, About and images
---------------------------

*   Books: create, upload cover (alt text required), set status and link, publish; reorder by an order number.
*   About and settings: edit text and links; replace the photo (alt text required); changes show publicly within a minute.
*   Upload errors: wrong type or over 2 MB shows a plain-language message and nothing is stored.

4.5 Subscribers and notifications
---------------------------------

| **Task** | **Flow** |
| --- | --- |
| See who follows | Subscribers screen shows counts for confirmed, pending, unsubscribed and bounced, and a searchable list. |
| Remove someone on request | Select subscriber, confirm by name; the record is permanently erased. |
| Export | Download CSV (email, status, dates). The action is logged. |
| Retry or send now | Notifications screen: Retry failed re-queues only unsent emails; Send now re-enqueues a notification whose job never started. |

5\. Screen state inventory
==========================

Every data-driven screen must design and test these states before it is complete.

| **Screen** | **Loading** | **Empty** | **Error** | **Other** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Home | Static; no spinner | Intro + subscribe + “The first piece is on its way” | Generic error page | — |
| Section index | Static; next page shows “Loading…” text link state | Empty-section message | Inline “Could not load more. Try again.” | End of list |
| Piece / book | Static | n/a | 404 | Draft (admin preview banner) |
| Subscribe form | Button “Sending…”, disabled | n/a | Invalid, rate-limited, server error | Pending confirmation |
| Confirm / unsubscribe | Button “Working…” | n/a | Invalid, expired | Already done |
| Admin lists | Skeleton rows | “Nothing yet” + primary action | Retry banner | Filtered-empty |
| Editor | Skeleton | New blank form | Save failed banner | Saved, saving, unsaved |
| Notifications | Skeleton | “No notifications yet” | Retry banner | Pending, partial, done, failed |

6\. Navigation rules
====================

*   The header is identical on every public page; the current section is underlined.
*   The subscribe form appears on Home, at the end of every piece and in the footer. It never appears as a pop-up or overlay.
*   Every email link goes to a stable canonical URL on the site; piece URLs never change after first publish.
*   The admin area is not linked from the public site. The author bookmarks /admin.
*   After every admin action the author lands back where they were, with a short confirmation message.
